decision: The learned path is sensitive to affine feature coordinates on selected fabric/color observations; this can be large despite the exact physical round trip. Do not replace inference normalization with central statistics: photo0 worsens, GFX changes are smaller, and texture remains soft. A future normalization-robust training test would be separate research after the original long-schedule review, not an established fix.
